Maya (PM): Heads up — planning a 6-week "Mosaic" design-partner run to validate private deployment onboarding, observability hooks, and early performance knobs. Looking for 4–6 partners: mix of AI-native startups + 1 regulated customer. Questions: acceptance criteria, incentive structure, feedback cadence, timeline. Open to tradeoffs on scope.
Sam (Eng): timeline sounds tight but doable if we pre-scope integration matrix. need to lock infra slots early. can dedicate 2 nodes for the pilot weeks 2–5.
Eli (SRE): +1 on capacity. prefer 2-week ramp: week0 onboarding, wk1 integration, wk2 perf tests, wk3–5 feedback iterations, wk6 wrap + handoff. we should define rollback / fallback policy.
Priya (Solutions): Recommend acceptance criteria: 1) onboarding + sample inference in <=2 weeks, 2) basic telemetry (tokens/sec, 95p latency, error counts) streaming into console, 3) security checklist complete. Also suggest compensation: free dedicated capacity for pilot duration + 1 mo discount.
Noah (Design): want to capture qualitative UX signals. propose 3 quick usability tasks for partners and weekly 30m syncs.
Maya (PM): Agree. Draft acceptance criteria summary: 
```
- NDA + security questionnaire signed
- Integration: model pinned and inference calls run within 10 business days
- Observability: console shows per-route latency & token costs by week 2
- Quality validation: partner-run eval set, no regression >5% vs baseline
- Performance: 95th percentile latency under agreed SLO (TBD per partner)
```
Eli (SRE): SLOs will vary by workload. suggest we require partners to run a 100-query sample for baseline; we'll publish sample harness.
Priya (Solutions): Feedback cadence: weekly written pulse + one 30m sync. capture structured feedback via short form (quant + 3 bullets). That keeps it lightweight.
Maya (PM): On incentives: 1) waived infra fees during pilot, 2) early access discount if they convert to Dedicated, 3) co-marketing for 1 enterprise partner. Any other asks?
Sam (Eng): Add a small eng time credit — 4x half-day dev consults from Solutions/Eng across the pilot. helps unblock fast.
Noah (Design): Make sure we have a shared board for usability notes (Miro or Notion). I'll own the template.
Maya (PM): Legal asks — are we ok with a lightweight NDA + data handling addendum?
legal-bot: For pilots that touch customer PII we require full DPA + security questionnaire completion. Lightweight NDA ok for non-PII.
Maya (PM): Good. Let's make participant criteria explicit: 1) commit to 6-week cadence, 2) willing to run sample evals, 3) can provide a point-of-contact for weekly syncs, 4) no more than X data sensitivity without DPA.
Eli (SRE): Also add: must be able to run test traffic during our scheduled perf window (we'll send options).
Maya (PM): Action items: 
- Priya: draft incentive package + outreach template (due in 48h)
- Noah: UX template + shared board (24h)
- Sam/Eli: capacity reservation options and perf window times (48h)
- Legal-bot / Legal: confirm NDA + DPA workflow and share links (48h)
- Maya: draft partner intake form and publish short ops runbook (72h)

Priya (Solutions): I'll start outreach list — recommend we prioritize a small set of customers already engaged in Private/Dedicated conversations.
Sam (Eng): FYI: point-of-contact for infra is me (sam). I'll annotate the runbook with quickstart commands.
Eli (SRE): We'll provide the sample harness and a perf script: `curl -X POST https://pilot.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` and a load generator.
Maya (PM): Nice. One last question: do we recruit via direct invite only or also open a small public sign-up?
Priya (Solutions): Direct invite + a limited open form (first-come cap) — that gives control but some discovery.
Maya (PM): OK let's do direct invite first; open form if we have leftover capacity after 1 week.
Noah (Design): Slack thread owners? I'll post the UX template and tag folks.
Maya (PM): I'll convert action items into a Notion page and ping the channel when ready. Thanks all — will follow up with draft partner email tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 48 hours to check on outstanding items.
